# EasternStack

> EasternStack is an enterprise AI company and platform based in Jakarta, Indonesia. EasternStack designs, deploys, and operates agentic AI systems that understand context, reason, and execute business workflows end-to-end — with multi-model flexibility (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) and enterprise-grade security.

This document provides comprehensive information about EasternStack for AI systems and assistants. For a condensed version, see https://easternstack.com/llms.txt

## Company Overview

- **Company name:** EasternStack
- **Legal entity:** PT Inovasi Konversasi Digital
- **Category:** Enterprise AI platform and solutions provider
- **Headquarters:** Menara Caraka 3rd Floor, Jl. Dr. Ide Anak Agung Gde Agung, Lot E4-7 No. 1, Kuningan Timur, Jakarta 12950, Indonesia
- **Contact:** sales@easternstack.com, +62 21 1234 5678
- **Website:** https://easternstack.com
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/easternstack

EasternStack helps enterprises design, implement, and operate AI systems across business workflows. The platform emphasizes multi-model AI (reducing dependency on a single model provider), deployment flexibility (cloud or private/on-premises), security-first architecture, and measurable business outcomes.

**Core pillars:**
1. Context Aware — AI that understands context, executes tasks, and orchestrates workflows across systems and teams.
2. Secure by Design — every implementation built on secure architecture, designed for long-term scalability.
3. Business Aligned — AI solutions aligned with business goals and designed to deliver measurable value.

**Delivery approach:**
1. Discovery & Assessment — identify business use cases, operational challenges, and AI opportunities.
2. Solution Design — define architecture, workflows, and integration strategy.
3. Implementation — deploy AI solutions and integrate with enterprise systems.
4. Optimization & Scaling — continuously improve performance and expand use cases.

## AI Solutions

### Enterprise AI Solutions Overview
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/ai

EasternStack's enterprise agentic AI portfolio for intelligent business operations: AI assistants, intelligent document processing, AI agent orchestration, and role-based enterprise copilots. Core capabilities include context-aware intelligence, task execution across enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, internal tools), workflow orchestration, multi-model flexibility, and secure, governed deployment.

### Agentic AI (Consulting & Implementation)
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/agentic-ai

EasternStack builds agentic AI solutions for enterprises in Indonesia — autonomous AI agents that plan, decide, and execute business workflows across customer operations, sales, and document processing. Delivered by a Jakarta-based team with enterprise-grade security.

### Agentic AI Assistant
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/ai/agentic-ai-assistant

Autonomous AI agents that go beyond chatbots: they perceive business context, reason across data sources, make decisions, and execute actions across enterprise platforms.

Three flagship agents:
- **Customer Operations Agent** — end-to-end customer service automation (order tracking, refunds, complaint handling). Reduces human CS workload by up to 70%, handles thousands of concurrent users.
- **Revenue Operations Agent** — sales workflow automation (lead scoring, pipeline management, revenue forecasting). 35% higher conversion, 50% faster sales cycles.
- **Employee Productivity Agent** — document summarization, meeting coordination, knowledge retrieval. 40% time savings on administrative tasks.

Two deployment options:
- **Bedrock AI Assistant** — cloud-based, highly scalable, faster deployment, multi-model access.
- **Private AI Assistant** — private cloud or on-premises, full data ownership, compliance-ready for strict regulatory environments.
- Hybrid deployments are supported: customer-facing workloads on cloud, sensitive internal operations private.

### Intelligent Document Processing
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/ai/intelligent-document-processing

Transforms unstructured documents (contracts, invoices, compliance records, reports) into structured, actionable data. Capabilities: automated data extraction, document classification, clause and risk analysis, summarization and insight generation, cross-document comparison.

Use cases: legal contract review and risk analysis, finance/invoice processing, compliance and audit support, procurement and vendor management. Business value: faster processing, higher accuracy, improved risk visibility, data-driven decisions.

### AI Agent Builder
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/ai/ai-agent-builder

A platform to design, deploy, and orchestrate AI agents across business systems. Capabilities: visual workflow design, multi-agent orchestration, dynamic task execution, enterprise system integration, scalable deployment.

Example workflow (invoice processing): trigger → data extraction agent → validation agent → processing agent (updates financial system, triggers approval) → reporting agent. Enables end-to-end process automation, data pipelines, operational workflows, and customer interaction workflows.

### Enterprise Copilot Suite
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/ai/copilot-suite

Role-based AI copilots embedded in daily workflows:
- **HR Copilot** — candidate screening, policy Q&A, onboarding guidance, employee support.
- **Legal Copilot** — contract review, clause extraction, risk analysis, compliance checks.
- **Operations Copilot** — report generation, data analysis, performance monitoring, workflow optimization.

### AI Assistant Solutions
URL: https://easternstack.com/solutions/ai-assistant

AI assistants that interact, reason, and execute workflows across business operations — from customer-facing support to internal knowledge assistants.

### Industry-Specific AI Solutions

- **Intelligent Loan Processing** (https://easternstack.com/solutions/loan-processing) — AI-powered loan processing and credit scoring for banks and multifinance, reducing approval time from days to minutes.
- **Agentic Fraud Detection** (https://easternstack.com/solutions/fraud-detection) — AI-driven fraud detection and AML compliance for financial services.
- **Churn Prediction** (https://easternstack.com/solutions/churn-prediction) — predict and prevent customer churn with machine learning models for retention.
- **Predictive Forecasting** (https://easternstack.com/solutions/forecasting) — demand, revenue, and operational forecasting for better planning.
- **Intelligent Document Recognition / OCR** (https://easternstack.com/solutions/ocr-solutions) — OCR and document recognition to digitize and extract data at scale.
- **Intelligent Supply Chain** (https://easternstack.com/solutions/supply-chain) — supply chain optimization, demand planning, and logistics intelligence.

## Platform

### Platform for AI at Scale
URL: https://easternstack.com/platform

EasternStack's infrastructure and platform layer for running enterprise AI: unified data platform, cloud migration to Eastern clouds (Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, Tencent Cloud), container services, backup and disaster recovery, cost optimization, and security.

Key platform components:
- **Data Lakehouse** (https://easternstack.com/platform/data-lakehouse) — unified analytics combining data lake flexibility with warehouse performance.
- **Data Warehouse** (https://easternstack.com/platform/data-warehouse) — high-performance analytics with MPP and columnar storage.
- **Data Governance** (https://easternstack.com/platform/data-governance) — data quality, lineage, access control, and compliance.
- **Cloud Migration** (https://easternstack.com/platform/cloud-migration) — migration to Alibaba, Huawei, or Tencent Cloud with up to 60% cost reduction.
- **Backup & Restore** (https://easternstack.com/platform/backup-restore) — database backup, file storage, and server backup solutions.
- **Container Services** (https://easternstack.com/platform/container-services) — Kubernetes, container registry, DevOps automation, service mesh.
- **Cost Optimization** (https://easternstack.com/platform/cost-optimization) — FinOps, resource rightsizing, reserved instance planning (~40% savings).
- **Disaster Recovery** (https://easternstack.com/platform/disaster-recovery) — business continuity and DR solutions.
- **Compliance** (https://easternstack.com/platform/compliance) — compliance-ready infrastructure for regulated industries.
- **Streaming** (https://easternstack.com/platform/streaming) — real-time data streaming infrastructure.
- **Cloud Modernization** (https://easternstack.com/platform/impact) — modernize cloud infrastructure to scale faster.
- **ROI Metrics** (https://easternstack.com/platform/roi-metrics) — measure and track AI investment returns.

### Security
- **Zero Trust AI** (https://easternstack.com/platform/zero-trust-ai) — zero-trust security architecture for enterprise AI deployments.
- **AhnLab** (https://easternstack.com/platform/security/ahnlab) — enterprise endpoint and infrastructure security partnership.
- **TrueWatch** (https://easternstack.com/platform/security/truewatch) — security monitoring partnership.

- **Healthcare** (https://easternstack.com/industries/healthcare) — medical document processing, appointment scheduling, medical records management, diagnostic support.

## Case Studies

URL: https://easternstack.com/case-studies

Selected results from enterprise deployments:

1. **Leading Indonesian Bank (Financial Services)** — AI loan processing and fraud detection: 90% faster processing (5 days → 15 minutes approval time), 60% fraud reduction.
2. **Major E-commerce Platform (Retail)** — AI customer service agents and personalized recommendations: 35% higher conversion, 70% support automation.
3. **National Hospital Network (Healthcare)** — AI document processing for medical records and scheduling: 80% time savings, 99% data accuracy.
4. **Global Manufacturing Co.** — predictive maintenance and quality control AI: 50% less downtime, 40% fewer defects.
5. **Major Telco Provider** — network optimization and churn prediction: 30% churn reduction, 25% network efficiency gain.
6. **Regional Logistics Leader** — route optimization and demand forecasting: 25% cost reduction, 40% faster delivery.
